description: This file defines a pipeline behavior for handling database transactions within an ASP.NET Core application using MediatR. It ensures that database transactions are correctly begun, committed, or rolled back around request handling.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions around request handling.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the request within a database transaction, committing if successful or rolling back if an exception occurs.
